name: hex
description: Local voice dictation for mac, windows and linux
one_liner: Hold a key, talk, let go, and your words get typed into whatever app you're using — all processed on your own computer, nothing sent to the cloud.
buyer: A busy professional who writes a lot of text all day (emails, notes, reports) and wants a faster, more private alternative to typing or cloud dictation tools.
business_use_cases: A lawyer or consultant dictates case notes and emails throughout the day without worrying about client data leaving their machine.
A support agent or recruiter dictates call summaries and CRM notes hands-free between calls, cutting admin time.
An IT department rolls it out org-wide as a privacy-compliant alternative to cloud dictation tools for regulated industries.

money_ideas.idea: A paid 'Pro' tier with advanced features (custom vocabularies, team deployment, premium models) on top of a free core app.
Bulk licensing deals sold directly to compliance-sensitive companies (legal, healthcare, finance) who need on-device dictation.

steal_this: Build and sell a tiny add-on pack of custom vocabulary/snippets for one specific profession (e.g. medical shorthand, legal citations) that plugs into it out of the box.
